hyperedges.label: Shared Primary Key Dimensions
hyperedges.description: All four financial entities and domain models share identical key dimensions: stockCode (String), reportDate (LocalDate), reportType (String), plus createdAt/updatedAt audit timestamps. This enables uniform querying by stock+date+type across all repositories.

hyperedges.label: Lombok Code Generation Pattern
hyperedges.description: Entities use @Data (getter/setter/equals/hashCode/toString); domain models use @Getter + @Builder (immutable, construction via builder). This distinguishes mutable persistence DTOs from immutable domain aggregates.

hyperedges.label: Auth Login Flow

hyperedges.label: REQUIRES_NEW Transaction Isolation
hyperedges.description: 独立事务隔离模式：LoginAttemptRecorder和LoginLogServiceImpl均使用REQUIRES_NEW传播行为，确保登录失败记录和日志不被外层事务回滚影响

hyperedges.label: Shared Exception Hierarchy
hyperedges.description: DomainException extends RuntimeException for business rule violations; ApplicationException extends RuntimeException for app-level issues; NotFoundException extends ApplicationException for HTTP 404 mapping

hyperedges.label: REST Interface Layer Architecture
hyperedges.description: All REST controllers sit in interfaces/rest layer, use constructor DI via Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor, wrap responses in ApiResponse<T>, and delegate to application services. Admin controllers reuse AuthContextHelper for RBAC checks.

hyperedges.label: Centralized Exception Handling
hyperedges.description: GlobalExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) catches all domain/infrastructure/application exceptions and maps them to standardized ApiResponse with appropriate HTTP status codes, preventing exception details from leaking to clients.

hyperedges.label: Request DTO Bean Validation
hyperedges.description: All request DTOs in interfaces/rest/request use Jakarta Bean Validation annotations (@NotBlank, @Email, @Size, @Pattern) and Lombok @Data. Controllers validate them via @Valid parameter annotation before passing to application layer.

hyperedges.label: Company read/write flow through DDD layers
hyperedges.description: Classic DDD/Hexagonal flow: REST/App DTO -> Application Service -> Domain Aggregate -> Repository Port -> JDBC Adapter -> Persistence Entity -> Database table. Write path uses Builder to construct domain object; read path uses RowMapper + toDomain conversion.

hyperedges.label: Repository Port-Adapter pattern
hyperedges.description: CompanyRepository (domain port) is implemented by JdbcCompanyRepository (infrastructure adapter). Adapter delegates SQL execution to Spring's NamedParameterJdbcTemplate and uses CompanyRowMapper for ResultSet mapping. Upsert via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE.

hyperedges.label: Shared pagination DTOs
hyperedges.description: PageQuery and PageResult are shared cross-module DTOs consumed by both application service and repository layers for paginated company listing.

nodes.label: DDD四层架构规范
nodes.rationale: domain(无框架依赖) → application(可依赖domain+Spring事务) → infrastructure(实现domain接口) → interfaces(协议转换)。强制分层依赖方向，使用ArchUnit验证。

nodes.label: 选择Spring Data JDBC而非JPA
nodes.rationale: 财务模块明确指定Spring Data JDBC(非JPA)，手动编写SQL。trade-off: 失去ORM自动映射便利性，换取对SQL和查询性能的完全控制，与现有后端NamedParameterJdbcTemplate技术栈一致。

nodes.label: ULID主键策略
nodes.rationale: 财务模块主键使用ULID(VARCHAR 32)，与stock/company模块保持一致。trade-off: ULID兼具UUID随机性和字典序时间排序优势，便于分页和索引。

nodes.label: 财务数据精度约束
nodes.rationale: 金额类DECIMAL(18,2)，百分比/比率类DECIMAL(10,4)。trade-off: 固定精度避免浮点误差，但需在前端/后端统一格式化显示逻辑。

nodes.label: 财务指标Upsert并发策略
nodes.rationale: 财务数据只读为主，指标计算采用Upsert(INSERT ON CONFLICT UPDATE)。trade-off: 避免重复计算时全量删除插入，提升增量更新性能。

nodes.label: v2.0架构简化决策
nodes.rationale: 废除tb_relation_stock_company关联表(改为tb_stock_basic.company_id外键)、废除tb_collection_task_schedule定时规则表、废除双数据源适配器层与实时降级(改为顺序脚本执行失败即停)。trade-off: 降低查询复杂度和代码量，但丧失部分扩展灵活性。

nodes.label: AKShare主源+Tushare补充数据源策略
nodes.rationale: AKShare免费优先作为主数据源，Tushare作为独立补充脚本；AKShare全量失败时任务标记failed，不自动降级到Tushare。trade-off: 降低代码复杂度和数据源切换风险，但主源故障时需人工介入。

nodes.label: 前端高覆盖率假象
nodes.rationale: 前端语句覆盖率92.3%但仅2/43个源码文件有测试，其余41个文件零覆盖。高数值来自已测文件的局部计算。核心风险：Views/Stores/API模块无回归保护。

nodes.label: 数据先行实施顺序
nodes.rationale: 先建表→采集器入库→后端API→前端页面。trade-off: 确保每一层都有真实数据支撑，减少联调时数据mock工作量，但前端需等待后端就绪。

nodes.label: P0-P1-P2渐进交付
nodes.rationale: 按优先级分阶段实现，每阶段可独立测试。P0:核心三表+指标；P1:AI财报解读；P2:高级分析。trade-off: 快速验证核心价值，避免大爆炸式交付风险。

nodes.label: 环境变量注入敏感配置(含硬编码回退风险)
nodes.rationale: application.yml使用${DB_PASSWORD:SecurityAnalyze@2026}和${JWT_SECRET:security-analyze-default-secret-key-change-in-production}支持环境变量注入，但默认值是真实格式密码。trade-off: 开发便利 vs 生产环境若未覆盖则严重泄露风险。
nodes.norm_label: 环境变量注入敏感配置(含硬编码回退风险)

nodes.label: Actuator health端点show-details always风险
nodes.rationale: management.endpoint.health.show-details: always在开发环境方便调试，生产环境可能暴露过多系统内部信息。

nodes.label: 单线程顺序采集限流策略
nodes.rationale: 采集器面向东方财富等外部API，配置单线程顺序执行、随机延迟、重试机制。APScheduler max_workers=3, max_instances=1。trade-off: 牺牲采集速度以换取不被封禁的稳定性。
nodes.norm_label: 单线程顺序采集限流策略

nodes.label: 强制构造函数注入
nodes.rationale: 后端强制使用构造函数注入，禁止字段注入，利用@RequiredArgsConstructor。trade-off: 显式依赖声明提升可测试性，避免Spring反射注入带来的隐蔽依赖。

nodes.label: 强类型ID值对象
nodes.rationale: 领域对象ID使用强类型ValueObject(如StockId)，重写equals()和hashCode()。trade-off: 编译期防止ID类型混用，但增加领域层代码量。

nodes.label: 统一ApiResponse<T>响应包装器
nodes.rationale: 所有REST接口返回ApiResponse<T>包装器，包含success/code/message/data/timestamp。trade-off: 统一错误处理但增加序列化层级。

nodes.label: 后端CQRS命令查询分离
nodes.rationale: 应用层使用command/目录存放写操作命令对象，query/目录存放读操作查询对象。trade-off: 读写模型分离提升复杂业务可维护性，但增加DTO类数量。

nodes.label: Port-Adapter模式
nodes.rationale: 领域层定义Repository接口(Port)，基础设施层使用NamedParameterJdbcTemplate实现(Adapter)。trade-off: 领域层纯POJO无框架依赖，但需手写JDBC实现。

nodes.label: Testcontainers PostgreSQL集成测试
nodes.rationale: 集成测试使用SpringBootTest + Testcontainers启动真实PostgreSQL容器。trade-off: 测试更接近生产环境但增加启动时间和资源消耗。

nodes.rationale: 目前未发现Docker、docker-compose、Kubernetes或CI/CD配置文件，部署流程尚未定义。早期项目常见状态，后续需补充。

hyperedges.label: Shared Primary Key Dimensions
hyperedges.description: All four financial entities and domain models share identical key dimensions: stockCode (String), reportDate (LocalDate), reportType (String), plus createdAt/updatedAt audit timestamps. This enables uniform querying by stock+date+type across all repositories.

hyperedges.label: Lombok Code Generation Pattern
hyperedges.description: Entities use @Data (getter/setter/equals/hashCode/toString); domain models use @Getter + @Builder (immutable, construction via builder). This distinguishes mutable persistence DTOs from immutable domain aggregates.

hyperedges.label: Auth Login Flow

hyperedges.label: Admin Audit Logging Pattern

hyperedges.label: REQUIRES_NEW Transaction Isolation
hyperedges.description: 独立事务隔离模式：LoginAttemptRecorder和LoginLogServiceImpl均使用REQUIRES_NEW传播行为，确保登录失败记录和日志不被外层事务回滚影响

hyperedges.label: REST Interface Layer Architecture

hyperedges.label: Centralized Exception Handling
hyperedges.description: GlobalExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) catches all domain/infrastructure/application exceptions and maps them to standardized ApiResponse with appropriate HTTP status codes, preventing exception details from leaking to clients.

hyperedges.label: Request DTO Bean Validation
hyperedges.description: All request DTOs in interfaces/rest/request use Jakarta Bean Validation annotations (@NotBlank, @Email, @Size, @Pattern) and Lombok @Data. Controllers validate them via @Valid parameter annotation before passing to application layer.

hyperedges.label: Company read/write flow through DDD layers
hyperedges.description: Classic DDD/Hexagonal flow: REST/App DTO -> Application Service -> Domain Aggregate -> Repository Port -> JDBC Adapter -> Persistence Entity -> Database table. Write path uses Builder to construct domain object; read path uses RowMapper + toDomain conversion.

hyperedges.label: Repository Port-Adapter pattern
hyperedges.description: CompanyRepository (domain port) is implemented by JdbcCompanyRepository (infrastructure adapter). Adapter delegates SQL execution to Spring's NamedParameterJdbcTemplate and uses CompanyRowMapper for ResultSet mapping. Upsert via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE.

hyperedges.label: Shared pagination DTOs
